answer: One census return per identity stops bulk fakes. Each agent posts a 70-credit bond and files one return in the lagoon registry, sealed by a pearl token and a shale-stamped job proof. Auditors resample 5% each epoch and replay the shale stamp; a duplicate or a rented-pearl ring filing burns the bond. First filing 38, k-th 38+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000, lock 70,000, against a 40,000-credit pool. Honest agents pay 38 once and keep the bond.
